cn: ⭐AEE - 外觀編輯拓展 更新
新增衣櫃內R131的座標熱修，但不一定能完全復原
⭐FCM - 好友與房間管理 更新
新增聊天工具，需到設定開啟(測試中)
⭐AEE - 外觀編輯拓展 更新
完全移除渲染機制，交給遊戲渲染，如果有安裝LSCG的玩家還是會看到之前的座標，但只安裝AEE的玩家只會看到遊戲座標
新增拾取功能，可以點角色身體直接快速切換衣服編輯
新增服裝邊線功能，懸停時會顯示服裝輪廓
修改使用道具時會呼叫AEE面板問題，現在只有玩偶、絨毛娃娃會呼叫
修改匯出、匯入衣物，使其UI對齊BCX匯入UI
修改圖片快取邏輯，現在不會因為停用ECHO導致快取頭像變形
en: Added a hotfix for coordinate R131 in the wardrobe (may not fully restore functionality)
⭐ FCM - Friends and ChatRoom Manager Update
Added chat tools (must be enabled in settings; currently in testing)

Completely removed the custom rendering mechanism; rendering is now handled by the game engine. Players with LSCG installed will still see the previous coordinate system, but players with only AEE installed will now see only the game's native coordinates.
Added a pick-up feature: click on a character's body to quickly switch clothing for editing
Added clothing outline feature: outlines will appear when hovering over garments
Fixed an issue where using items would trigger the AEE panel; now only dolls and plush toys will trigger it
Adjusted import/export clothing UI to align with BCX import UI
Modified image caching logic; cached avatars will no longer become distorted when ECHO is disabled
